latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: HIPAA Compliance Auditor skill introduced.

- Automatically detects and de-identifies PII and PHI in clinical/medical text for HIPAA compliance.
- Supports 18 HIPAA identifier categories, with context-aware detection and NLP.
- Provides audit logs for all redactions and confidence scoring for manual review.
- Usable via command line and Python API with customizable parameters.
- Includes detailed technical documentation, output formats, and risk assessment.
- Requires manual QA before use in compliance workflows.
